method.control: Upstream, original on/off, and partitioned off/full; lookup tables are retained
method.features: Each root is exposed as a separate private feature, in original lookup order
method.dependencies: Removing expansion makes marker-dependent passes inapplicable. Minimal expansion+pass+sweep cases test them independently.
method.cleanup: without_sweep intentionally retains private zero-advance glyphs: invalid final output, diagnostic only
method.visibility: Wrapped samples entirely visible; nowrap is layout-only; glyph caches warm
method.seeders: Bounded windows include current source; read original future source classes, never neighboring hash states. Each distance is a separate bounded contextual stage at original hash position.
method.flags: unsafe_to_break counts from HarfBuzz default buffer flags, before signature/timing calls

feedback_without_rtl.interpretation: No RTL or gender seeding: feedback changes the fifth state; fold/sweep disabled only to inspect private slots
